name: truing_hal
description: Hardware-facing interface contracts (acoustic, runout, position, operator intent, telemetry, clock) plus their non-hardware stub/synthetic implementations (SPEC §5, §9.1, §10.1, §12.2, §12.4, §14.5). Interfaces are C vtables; implementations here are framework-free so the workflow can run with zero hardware attached. Phase 1f adds the audio front-end contract (recorded and synthetic sources), the pluck actuator contract with a fake, and the REAL acoustic subsystem composed on truing_dsp.
